description: KNaNb₂O₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.08 Å. Na is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-3.01 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-14°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.20 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-12°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.23 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K and two Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Nb atoms.
